mentions.name: Who's Hiring Job Board
mentions.description: A scraper that pulls every job posting from the Hacker News Who's Hiring thread and runs it through DeepSeek to parse the unstructured text into a uniform schema (role, company, location, remote, salary, stack), presented in a searchable and filterable UI. Built with FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, containerized on AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB with the frontend on Amplify. Email-based job match notifications and saving jobs are planned features.
mentions.problem: Existing Who's Hiring thread tools lacked the filtering and UI the author wanted.
